summary: Link the smoke journal key literals to their Go constants (TKT-56/S4 ai-review)
description:
Incidental finding from TKT-56 Slice 4's adversarial review (fable-5).

scripts/smoke.sh hard-codes the v1/v2 journal key ids and secrets (and the base64 of the v1 secret) for the packaged-binary verify-journal checks; journal_smoke_test.go declares the same values as smokeKIDv1/smokeKIDv2/smokeKeyv1/smokeKeyv2. There is no compile-time link between them.

Cosmetic today: drift fails LOUDLY (the positive packaged check fails, or the fixture guard trips), so this is maintainability, not correctness — which is exactly why it was not fixed inside the TKT-56 diff. Options: have the Go test emit the values to a file smoke.sh sources, or a tiny subcommand that prints them.
